datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule across Uganda during 2016. Geographic boundaries with IPC phase classifications (representing food insecurity severity levels) were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for February, June, and October 2016 snapshots. This dataset represents post-assessment impact classifications of food insecurity conditions.
